basis_label: San Diego Zoo: African elephant shoulder height and morphology
author: jimmyho905 on Sketchfab
note: African-elephant exterior illustration by jimmyho905, uniformly calibrated to the catalog’s 3.2 m representative adult-male shoulder height. In this neutral pose the highest mesh point is the dorsal withers above the forelegs; the head, ears and trunk are lower, so the Y extent measures foot to shoulder rather than body length or head height. A predominantly frontal resting view preserves the shoulder-height size comparison; drag to inspect the whole, longer body. The artist identifies the model as African Elephant; this is an illustrative savanna-elephant appearance, not a specimen scan, verified individual or measured male. Source geometry and textures are retained, the neutral skin bind pose is baked and the rig removed, and tangents are regenerated. No independent-axis scaling, shortened body or cropped anatomy. CC BY 4.0; adaptation by Universe Scales.

processing.description: Bake neutral bind pose; deduplicate, flatten, join, weld; regenerate MikkTSpace tangents; prune and quantize. Preserve source textures and all body geometry. No simplification needed.
processing.withers_landmark: Highest dorsal midline point over forelegs; centered world-space X near 0, Z between 0 and 0.007 source units, above minimum foot Y.
